approvals.summary: Consent valid for rewards-personalization scope. No protected attributes utilized.
Verified zero presence of timed challenges, public leaderboards, or manipulative urgency. Hard gates passed successfully.
Story-1 and journey-candidate-1 exhibit flawless alignment with customer motivation for learning mastery.
Three-episode mini-journey structure cleanly opens with goal progress, develops through educational insight and quiz components, and exits via goal-linked reward.
Mini-journey structure successfully mapped from snapshot to educational mastery and goal-linked rewards without competitive interference.

Mandatory components (POINTS_BALANCE, GOAL_PROGRESS_CARD, LEARNING_MISSION_CARD, QUIZ_CARD, COMPREHENSION_FEEDBACK_CARD, CONFIDENCE_PROGRESS_CARD, EDUCATIONAL_INSIGHT_CARD) correctly ordered and populated with real customer data.
All hard rules respected: cognitive load within limits, span layout fully specified, dark patterns and timed elements strictly suppressed.
Stage R final validation passed. Coherence and continuity checks are clean, and all constraints are satisfied.
